definitions.on_time: 2 min early to 7 min late at a scheduled timepoint (MTA definition)
definitions.late_over_15_min: arrived more than 15 minutes after the scheduled time
definitions.canceled_by_mta: MTA's own real-time feed marked the trip CANCELED
definitions.no_realtime_record: scheduled trip never appeared in the real-time feed; a likely missed trip, but a bus with failed tracking equipment looks the same
definitions.pct_failed_15min_or_missing: scheduled stop visits that were 15+ min late, canceled, or had no record, out of all monitored visits with an outcome
definitions.drove_past: between two position reports that bracket the stop (normally about 30 seconds apart), the bus averaged at least 15 mph (more when reports are farther apart) and MTA's feed never reported it stopped there. A bus that slows, opens its doors and pulls out cannot average that speed over the interval, so this is a conservative count
definitions.stopped: MTA's feed reported the bus stopped at that stop
definitions.full_service: a scheduled timepoint visit where the trip ran, the bus was on time, and it stopped. Counted against it: trips canceled or never seen, stops MTA flagged as skipped, buses that left 2+ min early or came 7+ min late, and on-time buses that drove past. On-time visits whose stop behavior was unclear are left out; including them as stops gives the upper bound
definitions.left_without_waiting: reached a timepoint 2+ minutes before its scheduled time and left 2+ minutes early instead of waiting for the scheduled departure
